$comment: The stages of the staged workflows (docs/train-checklist.md, "Staged CI"): one table that the gate jobs, the final `stages` job and their tests read. `gates` maps each gate job to the fast jobs it waits for (besides `plan`); `stage2` maps each long job to the gates it needs (a stage-2 job waits only for the gates of its own OS); `parallel` are fast jobs in no gate: they run at the same time, stay required (a failed one fails the run) and no stage-2 job waits for them. Matrix jobs that span several OSes (ci.yml crate, paddock-dev, app) cannot be in a per-OS gate until they are split per OS; they are `parallel`. A new job goes in exactly one place here; conformance/test/stage-gate.test.mjs holds the workflow files to this table.
